preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 100.
The number of caves n must be between 3 and 1000.
The number of tunnels m must be at least n and at most the minimum of n(n-1)/2 and 2000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= a_i <= 10**9 for a_i in a)
preconditions.description: Each monster's power value a_i must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= b_i <= 10**9 for b_i in b)
preconditions.description: Each power increase value b_i must be between 1 and 10^9.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= u_i <= n and 1 <= v_i <= n and u_i != v_i for u_i, v_i in tunnels)
preconditions.description: Each tunnel must connect two distinct caves within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The output must be the smallest possible power the hero must start with to beat all monsters.
